title: Design System: Batcave765 — Make it fast

artwork.purpose: Semibold Space Grotesk converted to SVG paths; GitHub supplies body typography.

components.name: Profile poster
components.description: One static SVG at assets/profile.svg; mobile alternative assets/profile-mobile.svg. Native project/contact links below.

components.name: Diagonal ribbon
components.description: Ivory MAKE IT FAST ribbon, -4 degrees desktop and -5 degrees mobile, with ascending chevrons.

narrative.overview: Single-page engineering poster. The user explicitly chose a compact image-led README. Oversized split name, diagonal ribbon, engineering proof, two projects, compressed toolkit and four native links.
keyCharacteristics: Oversized type colliding with a diagonal ribbon

rules.name: One-page rule
rules.body: Keep the README to one compact composition plus native project/contact links.

dos: Preserve comprehensive factual alt text and native actions.
donts: Do not restore long resume sections, skills tables, or extra banners.
Do not add fake interactive controls inside the image.
